persona.title: Pretend you are…
persona.text: Pretend you are Faith, 66, one of Daraja's testers. Your sister sells honey at the farmers market, and you want to check if the Break-Even app would really help her. Today your job is to use the app and tell the people who made it, clearly, what works and what is confusing.

challenge.intro: Now you are Faith, testing Break-Even for your sister. Nobody will tell you which button to press. Use what you learned. Do NOT press 📨 Send to Claude — nothing needs to be sent. When you finish, tap Check my work.
challenge.start: Open Feedback Studio with the normal link (not a 🧪 test copy). If the welcome card shows, tap 'I’ll look around myself'. If a card says 'You have … comments from last time', tap '🗑 Start fresh'. If an app is already open, tap '‹ Start screen'. Then look at the button '💬 Comments (…)' at the bottom: if the number is not 0, tap it, tap 'Clear' → OK, and tap '✕ Comments' to close the list. (This app hides the usual 🧹 erase link at the bottom of the page, so these are the steps. Verified 10 Oct: all four checks false after this.)

tasks.text: Open Break-Even inside Feedback Studio and use it for your sister: she sells a jar of honey for $15, one jar costs her $9, and her monthly costs (market stall fees, jars and labels) are $3,000. Put her numbers in.
tasks.hint: Open Break-Even from the Quick picks list in Feedback Studio (not in a separate tab), so the studio can see your taps. Then type the three numbers in Break-Even's boxes.

tasks.text: Leave at least three comments about Break-Even: one thing you liked, one thing that confused you, and one idea to make it better. Speak them or type them.
tasks.hint: Tap '💬 Comments' at the bottom, type in the box '…or type a comment' and tap Add. Each comment needs at least three words. Or press the red button and talk.

tasks.text: Point at the one box in Break-Even that confused you most, and leave a comment about that exact box.
tasks.check: (function(){try{var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('feedback_studio_v1')||'null');if(!d||!d.notes)return false;var N=d.notes.filter(function(n){return n&&String(n.where||'').toLowerCase().indexOf('breakeven')>=0});var said=function(n){return (n.kind==='typed'||n.kind==='voice')&&String(n.text||'').trim().split(/\s+/).length>=3};return N.some(function(n){return said(n)&&!!n.about})}catch(e){return false}})()
tasks.hint: Tap 👆 Point, tap the box in the app so it gets an orange outline, and THEN type or say your comment while pointing is still on.

tasks.text: Mark one moment that matters, so the makers can see exactly what was on the screen at that moment.
tasks.hint: One of the four buttons at the bottom has a red flag. Use it while Break-Even is open.

ownWords.question: In your own words, what is this app for?
keyIdeas: you test an app inside it and say or type what you think as you go
comments get the time, and you can point at the exact thing you mean
it builds one clear report for the people who made the app

lines: Welcome. This short video explains Feedback Studio. In about four minutes you will know what it is for and how to use it.
First, the problem. When someone tries a new app, they notice lots of small things. A button they cannot find. A word they do not understand.
But by the time they sit down to write about it, half of it is gone. And a message like, it was confusing, does not help anyone fix anything.
Feedback Studio solves this. You open the app inside Feedback Studio, use it, and say what you think at the same moment. Every comment gets its exact time. At the end it builds one clear report.
Who is it for? Anyone who builds an app and wants honest reactions, and anyone helping them test it.
Let us look at the screen. At the top is a box that says paste the address of the app you want to review, and an Open button.
In the middle is a list of Quick picks, apps you can try it on straight away. Tap a name and that app opens inside the studio.
When an app is open, it fills most of the screen. Use it normally: tap, type, scroll. A button at the top left, Start screen, closes it and brings you back here.
Now the bar at the bottom. The big red button is the microphone. Press it and talk. Each thing you say becomes its own comment.
Pause between thoughts. Each pause starts a new comment. If voice does not work on your device, you can type instead.
Next to it is Point, with a finger. Tap Point, then tap something in the app. It gets an orange outline, and your next comment is about that exact thing.
While pointing is on, taps do not open anything in the app. Tap Stop pointing when you finish.
The gold button is Mark, with a flag. Tap it at a moment that matters, like when something goes wrong. It drops a marker at that second.
The purple button is Screenshot. It takes a picture of the app and keeps it with the report.
The green button, Done, builds the report when you have finished.
And Comments, with a number, opens your list. Here is the comments panel.
At the bottom is a box that says or type a comment, with an Add button. Each comment shows its time, and a small x deletes it.
At the top of the panel you choose who the report is for: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, or my developer.
Then tap I'm done, build the report. Clear, next to it, empties the list and starts fresh.
The report lists every comment with its time and the taps you made. Copy to clipboard and Download let you paste it into your A.I. or send it to your developer.
There is also a button called Send to Claude. That one sends the report to the Daraja team, the people who make these apps. Use it when you are reviewing one of ours.
How to start, in your first two minutes. Tap a quick pick, press the red button, and say one thing you notice. Then open Comments and see it written down with its time.
A good comment is short and specific. Not, this is bad. Better: I did not understand the word variable in the second box.
Your comments stay on your device until you clear them. If you come back later, it asks whether to keep adding or start fresh. There is no account.
Feedback Studio is the tool my testers use to tell me what they find.
That is all you need. Open an app, talk while you use it, and let the report do the remembering.

daily.task: Make one new short note in Feedback Studio about any app. Don’t tap Send.

explore.name: 🏁 Start screen
explore.find: It opens here. Tap “‹ Start screen” at the top to come back.
explore.try: Tap one of the Quick picks. Go back, paste an app address in the top box and tap Open. Try a wrong address too and see what happens.

explore.name: 🎙 The red talk button
explore.find: Open an app, then look at the bar under it.
explore.try: Tap 🎙, say a short comment, pause, say another. Tap 🎙 again to stop. Check that your words appear on the right with a time.

explore.name: 👆 Point
explore.find: Open an app, then tap “👆 Point” in the bar under it.
explore.try: Tap a button inside the app, then say or type what you think about it. Tap “Stop pointing”. Check the comment says what you pointed at.

explore.name: 🚩 Mark and 📸 Screenshot
explore.find: They sit in the bar under the open app.
explore.try: Tap “🚩 Mark” two times. Tap “📸 Screenshot” and read the card that opens, then tap “Got it”. Check both show in the comment list.

explore.name: 💬 Session comments
explore.find: Look at the “Session comments” list beside the app.
explore.try: Type in “…or type a comment” and tap Add. Tap “Show all”. Delete one comment with ✕. Change “For: Claude” to each choice.

explore.name: 📄 The report
explore.find: Tap “✅ I'm done — build the report” under the comments.
explore.try: Read the report. Tap “Copy to clipboard”, “Download .txt” and “📎 Add my pictures”. Look at “📨 Send to Claude”, don’t send. Tap “✕ Close”.

explore.name: 🗂 Comments from last time
explore.find: Leave some comments, then close and open Feedback Studio again.
explore.try: A card asks about your old comments. Tap “▶ Keep adding to them”. Next time, try “🗑 Start fresh”.

explore.name: 🧹 Clear
explore.try: Read what it asks. Tap Cancel first, then OK. Check that the list is empty.

explore.name: ❓ The round ? button
explore.find: Tap the round ? in the bottom corner.
explore.try: Open each line: text size (Aa), Ask an AI, More from Daraja, Which AI do you use, See it as a new user, Help. Close it. Leave “Start fresh” for the very end.
